FINDINGS_RANKED.what: The repair is confined to Clinical meaning while CLAIM 032's Summary still carries, as a load-bearing verbatim quote, Aldaz's 'appears not to be deleterious OR CARCINOGENIC in the longer-lived heterozygous mice'. The new limit contradicts the carcinogenicity half of that quote. A claim whose Summary quotes what its own limit denies is the defect class BATCH_20260914_005 closed elsewhere.

The BATCH_20260815_001 qualification does not merely need extending: it attributes to PAPER 078 (PMID 17360458) the framing 'unremarkable in unchallenged assays', and PAPER 078's own Table 1 is the source of the untreated spontaneous excess. The unchallenged-normality observation belongs to PAPER 077 (PMID 17575124, NMBA). Canon's own ledger already separates them at DL-MECH-101 and DL-MECH-102; the claim conflates them.

The §3 assertion that the three competing VOPP1 mechanisms 'live only in the abstracts of FT-108 to FT-112, closed access and unread' is false. paper_registry_current.md:7034 (PAPER 095's Note, canonical) names them and states that the corpus IMPORTS VOPP1's lysosomal identity from FT-110. The 400-character window never measured paper_registry, which carries 16 of the VOPP1 mentions.

CORPUS P363 and CORPUS P295 DO say the promotion happened, in a '**Resolved (BATCH_20260806_002):**' field naming PAPER 058 / PAPER 057 and their receipts. The candidate's measurement read the Status field only, so two of its four subjects are mis-described, and its 37/33/4 census is not reproducible: an Identifier-keyed join gives population 45, five records silent in the whole record, including CORPUS P182 (PMID 30619736 to PAPER 032) which is outside the candidate's perimeter.

The proposed meaning is too wide by one measurable case: 'or under an expression of concern that invalidates its use' immediately captures PMID 16223882 (Editorial Expression of Concern PMC5402418, PAPER 082 under PUBLICATION_INTEGRITY_HOLD), which the candidate does not move. Also, the exclusion of `filtered_out` is argued against a supplied gloss ('at screening'); the table's own text is 'Excluded — reason logged'.

One sub-item of the specification's DL-MECH-018 row was not applied: 'Metabolismo Acetyl-CoA come hub sperimentale is annotation, not measurement'. The heading still reads 'hub sperimentale' and the enrichment clause carries no annotation marker. Same shape at DL-MECH-036, where the instruction that the Q230P corollary must carry the unpublished-observation premise is recorded beside the finding but not executed at the corollary bullet.

entries[37]'s declaration uses the same `audit` / `auditors` vocabulary as entries[34], but its two 'auditors' are geometry re-readings of S2B, not a blind triple audit; it declares three revisions against two verdicts, and the third revision moved `artifact`/`anchor` off the PNG onto the PDF, which no reading audited. Separately, the commit message's 'locator working-tree: 1 declared' understates the act: contradicts_locator went 31 to 33.

Provenance asymmetry: the landed DL-MECH-046 text carries 'Table 1, aggiudicata sulla pagina resa a 300 dpi', the proposed canonical claim text does not, and all five fingerprinted artefacts of PMID 17360458 are ABSENT from this checkout. Canon is harder to correct than a ledger. Also: the candidate sources a primary datum to PAPER 053's Note (canon as its own evidence) while manifest entries[2] carries the source's verbatim '5-fold higher (P = 0.03)'.
